title: Project P.I.T.T. Achievements Guide: Complete 23-Achievement Checklist
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Achievements Guide: Complete 23-Achievement Checklist
quickAnswer: Project P.I.T.T. has 23 achievements (14 with public descriptions, 9 hidden). Preserve the in-game checklist and prioritize finishing the 300 combo goal, reaching 1 trillion, and buying every item before you trigger the final ending when practical; available evidence does not prove an irreversible lockout or that you must start a new save. See the x300 page, progression page, and automation page as next steps.
description:
One-line summary: This guide preserves the verified 23-achievement checklist and gives short, answer-first advice for Consumerism, Speed Radar/FAST!, x300, RICH!, purchase-every-item timing, and finishing before the ending.

Checklist (23 achievements — names preserved exactly):
QWACK!, KACHING!, MORE!, MESS!, EXTRA!, LAG!, FIESTA!, GAMBLING!, STUFFED!, WEIRD!, MEGA!, RICH!, CONSUMERISM!, FAST!, BAD?, UP?, INVISIBLE?, HEAVY?, OPEN?, LOOP?, SECRET?, END?, END!

Evidence note: Steam shows 14 of these with public descriptions and 9 with hidden descriptions; this guide preserves that distinction and does not invent extra hidden requirements.

Consumerism
Answer-first: Consumerism is described in the verified checklist as unlocking and buying everything. Plan automation and funds to cover all unlocks before attempting final-ending progression when practical.

Speed Radar / FAST!
Answer-first: The FAST! achievement represents speed/throughput and the verified checklist cites 400 products per minute. Players asking about the “Speed Radar” should treat that display as the in-game measure for FAST! (no separate achievement named Speed Radar is created or assumed).

x300
Answer-first: The x300 (300 combo) target is a known completion goal referenced by players. If you need guidance, consult the x300 page as your next step for strategies to reach the 300 combo milestone.

RICH!
Answer-first: RICH! is part of the preserved checklist and is tied to reaching the high-currency threshold (players commonly reference 1 trillion). If you are close, prioritize progression and automation to reach 1 trillion before final-ending progression when practical.

Purchase-every-item timing
Answer-first: Buying every item is the core of Consumerism. Where practical, finish purchasing every item before final-ending progression so you don’t have to backtrack; the available evidence does not prove an irreversible lockout or that a new save is required after the ending.

Achievements to Finish Before the Ending
Answer-first: Recommend finishing these when practical before triggering final-ending progression: the 300 combo (x300), the 1 trillion currency milestone (RICH!-level progression), and purchase‑every‑item (Consumerism). This is a precautionary workflow based on community reports; the current evidence does not prove these achievements become impossible after the ending or that a fresh save is required.
Next steps: See x300 page, progression page, and automation page for focused guides to reach those goals.

FAQ — players entering the ending loop while missing items
Q: I entered the ending loop but still need 300 combo, 1 trillion, or to buy every item. Are those impossible now?
A: Available evidence does not prove any of those achievements are definitely impossible after ending progression. Community reports show players sometimes enter the ending loop while missing those goals, so the safe recommendation is to complete x300, 1 trillion, and purchasing-every-item before final-ending progression when practical, but do not assume a guaranteed lockout.

Q: Do I need a new save after the ending to get achievements?
A: The evidence does not require claiming a new save is mandatory. Plan to finish the three priority goals before final-ending progression when practical; if you’ve already triggered the ending, check progression and automation strategies to recover.
